# heytownhall_organization (Data Source)

The organisation the management token belongs to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "heytownhall_organization" "this" {}

output "organization_name" {
  value = data.heytownhall_organization.this.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organisation's id.
- `name` (String) The organisation's name.
- `spend_cap_cents` (Number) The monthly spending cap in US cents, or null for no cap.
